papers.title: Vascular Function and Cardiorespiratory Fitness in Adults Who Use Nicotine Vapes
papers.summary: Cross-sectional study of 58 young adults without cardiovascular risk factors: 17 daily nicotine vape users, 19 cigarette smokers and 22 nonusers. Flow-mediated dilation was lower with vaping (5.5%) and smoking (4.4%) than in nonusers (8.3%), as was carotid artery reactivity. Peak oxygen uptake was lower in vape users than nonusers; lung function did not differ.
papers.short_title: vaping, vascular function and fitness in young adults

papers.title: Longitudinal Proteomic Profiling of Blood Pressure in the Community
papers.summary: No abstract was available for this study, so no results are reported here. Judging from its title, it measures large panels of blood proteins at repeated time points in a community cohort to examine how they relate to blood pressure. See the full paper in JACC for the cohort, methods and findings.
papers.short_title: proteomic profiling of blood pressure over time
